ED-1 Emergency department board and triage (Release D, the department sprint the owner approved on 25 November 2026), built at the recommended option of each open question, not yet answered by the owner: Q-ED-1 A (an ED patient is a row of the live waiting list plus an ED record), Q-ED-2 A (0169: the front desk arrives and sees the board without the complaint, nurses also triage, clinicians and doctors also record the disposition), Q-ED-3 A (an emergency search's patient may be put on the board while the member's own break-glass grant for them is active; Rahman and the DPO review this basis before 0168 is signed), Q-ED-4 A (a complaint of 1-120 characters, never shown to the front desk, never in an audit row), Q-ED-5 A (two-step disposition), Q-ED-6 A (admission requests kept on the ED record until wards ship), Q-ED-7 A (no new write basis).
